welcome.title: Send any file to anyone
welcome.description: Any size, anywhere. No account, no cloud storage.

receive.title: They don’t need an account
receive.description: Share a code, QR or link. They open it in AlterSend or right in their browser.

private.title: Straight from you to them
private.description: Nothing is stored in between, so keep AlterSend open until it’s done.

network.title: Works on any network
network.description: If Wi-Fi or a VPN blocks the direct path, our relay carries it, still encrypted.

proIntro.title: Free and open source
proIntro.openBody: Anyone can read the code on GitHub.
proIntro.relayBody: Direct transfers stay free. We pay for the relay servers.
proIntro.supportBody: Pro keeps AlterSend independent. No ads, no data selling.
